I traveled deep into Chhattisgarh, India, to meet the Ramnami tribe, a community known for tattooing the name of Ram across their bodies as an expression of faith, identity, and defiance.

I sat with the Ramnami, learned the story behind their remarkable tradition, and eventually received a Ram tattoo of my own, done by hand using their traditional methods.
